name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.172.0 — Client request lifecycle, four defect fixes (q240): POST /client/__notes/reopen now refuses 409 once design/mocks/status.json carries marks.approved — the same sign-off cut-off /client/__walk/exclusion already enforces — so a stale client tab can no longer un-withdraw a request after sign-off and let the next materialize retire the exclusion row derived from it; the request cards' "Put it back" control is omitted from every surface once approved, and ships hidden on an open request so the withdraw handler can reveal it; walk.browser.js's withdraw handler now paints the full withdrawn shape a reload renders (data-resolution, the withdrawn sentence, withdraw gone, putback revealed) instead of the bare word "Closed", and the exclusion row's putback handler drops its own row (dropped verdict, verdict buttons and "Change answer" gone, the dropped sentence activated from the section's new data-said-dropped) instead of leaving live verdicts on a claim that just went away; waiveNote stamps resolution: 'waived' so a seven-day-silence close renders its own sentence rather than the bare "Closed"; and viewer.css's .wk-home/.wk-more/.wk-j-cta/.wk-req-link gain the '.wk ' ancestor prefix that beats '.wk a { color: inherit }', the same specificity defect specs/20260912/06 D9 fixed on the review page. 7.171.0 — Review close no longer deletes tests. Close-time expiry stays classification-only — it still counts born/kept/retired onto the review row and names what is retirable — but writes nothing to the tree and makes no commit; the deliberate 'test-expiry --all-done --apply' sweep is now the only path that deletes a test. The classifier's two fail-safe holes are repaired in the same landing: a 'superseded' owner spec counts as closed alongside 'done', and an unreadable spec file under specs/ keeps every test citing its derived AC-ID prefix, warning once on stderr instead of silently letting a collided ID fall open. 7.170.0 — The design stage prints the work, not the inventory. `design-atlas.js check` collapses its advisory warn lines to one `⚠️ <n> warn(s) — --verbose to list` count and omits the per-screen kit/bespoke breakdown, keeping the running unabsorbed total on every run; `mocks-driver.js notes open` collapses the answered-question history to a count and stops the journey-listed open notes after twenty with a `… <n> more open note(s)` tail. `--verbose` and `--all` restore the full pre-change output byte-for-byte, and no gate, refusal or served page changes behavior.
